spans.s: कोट m. 1. A foot; 2. a hut, a shed; 3. crookedness (physical and moral).
कोट्ट m. A fort.
कोटर m.n. the hollow of a tree, त्वत्तीरे तरुकोटरांतरगतो गंगे विहंगे वरम् Vālmīki, स्फुटति कनकगौरः कोटरेषु द्रुमाणाम् Rt.i.26.
कोट्टार m. 1. A fortified town, a stronghold; 2. the stairs of a pond; 3. a libertine; 4. a well, a pond.
कोटरी f. 1. A naked woman; 2. an epithet of the goddess Durgā.
कोटरी f. 1. A naked woman; 2. an epithet of the goddess Durgā.
कोट्टवी f. 1. A naked woman with dishevelled hair; 2. an epithet of the goddess Durgā.

कोटि(टी) f. 1. The curved end of a bow, भूमिनिहतैककोटि कार्मुकम् R.xi.31; 2. the end or extremity in general, अंगदकोटिलग्नम् R.vi.14, vii.46, viii.36; 3. the edge or point of a weapon; 4. the highest point, excess, eminence, excellence, e.g. आनंदस्य परां कोटिमगमत्; 5. the horns of the moon, K.S.ii.26; 6. ten millions, a crore, M.i.63, R.xii.82; 7. the complement of an arc to 90° (in math.); 8. the side of a right-angled triangle (in math.); 9. a class, a department; 10. one side of a debatable question.
